title: FW26 and the Archaeology of Formative Desire: sabukaru Meets Hyein Seo
summary: Hyein Seo is one of the most consequential figures in Korean fashion, a Royal Academy of Fine Arts Antwerp alumna whose return to Seoul coincided with a period of profound change in the city’s creative culture. More than a decade into HYEIN SEO, the label has evolved with Hyein’s own changing perspective, allowing each collection to reflect the ideas, refer…
